desc:
Welcome to Would You Rather: Girls Boys Dress Up Outfit Tower! 👗👕

Climb the tower and pick a door at every stage
Two items to choose from, or take the surprise door and see what you get! 🎁

Get unique hairstyles, clothes, faces, accessories and more to build your look 👗✨

The doors change every few minutes, so every climb is different 🔄

Millions of different combinations to choose from! 🎲

Reach the top, save your final outfit and show it to your friends
Who got the best style? 😆

Like the game 👍 and Favorite ⭐ for new items and updates
Join the group for a reward!
